scripts.frontend:check: npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
scripts.backend:format:check: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run ruff format --check .
scripts.backend:lint: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run ruff check .
scripts.backend:typecheck: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run mypy app tests
scripts.backend:import: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run python -c "from app.main import create_app; assert callable(create_app)"
scripts.backend:check: npm run backend:format:check && npm run backend:lint && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run backend:test && npm run backend:import
scripts.database:test:unit: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run pytest -q tests/unit/db/test_metadata.py tests/unit/db/test_database_safety.py tests/unit/db/test_session.py tests/unit/db/test_snapshots.py
scripts.database:test:integration: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run pytest -q -m postgres tests/integration/db/test_reports_and_drafts.py tests/integration/db/test_sources_and_imports.py tests/integration/db/test_datasets_and_metrics.py tests/integration/db/test_analysis_jobs.py tests/integration/db/test_versions_exports_assets.py
scripts.database:migrations:verify: uv --cache-dir backend/.uv-cache --directory backend run pytest -q -m postgres tests/integration/db/test_migrations.py tests/integration/db/test_catalog.py
scripts.database:check: npm run database:test:unit && npm run database:test:integration && npm run database:migrations:verify
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -p mkt-rp-assistant --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -p mkt-rp-assistant --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml down
scripts.foundation:check: npm run environment:test && npm run environment:check && npm run infra:validate && npm run frontend:check && npm run backend:check
